title: System-Viz Filesystem Coverage — every H: file represented
brief: Add L11 (filesystem bundles) + L12 (canonical files) layers to PRISM's system-viz graph so every file on the H: drive is represented — either as its own L12 node or aggregated into an L11 bundle. Augment script with worktree-canonical dedup (H:/prism + H:/prism-* collapse to one namespace), data-heavy + binary-heavy bundling for archive dirs, atomic idempotent merge. /loop until every H: domain walked.
scope_note: MS0 scope EXPANDED 2026-05-15-alpha-continuation: foundation (Phase 0+1) shipped first session; Phase 2 (4 H:/prism subtrees) + Phase 3 (4 non-prism H: roots, including 53 H:/prism-* worktrees with canonical-dedup) shipped in continuation. Every file on H: drive now represented — 1,573,752 files across 70 namespaces. Graph 92,405 → 285,440 nodes (+209%). Future MS1 (if needed) would cover cron-driven re-walks + drift detection.

Was expected to be massive — actually near-empty (12 files: cleanup scripts, .pid, .bak). Pruned over time.

tribal_learnings: Walk leaf subtrees not parents — full H:/prism walk OOMs during merge of 92MB JSON; per-leaf (≤30k files) completes in seconds
tail -30 truncates the [merge] success log line — always capture full stderr+stdout on --apply
Single-process walks safe even at 91% commit pressure; parallel Agent+bash+node is the fork-storm trigger
Data-heavy bundling crushes archive dirs (Docustrata 80k PDFs → 11 bundles, mcp-server/dist 2752 files → 1 bundle)
Bundle-threshold=200 too generous for many-small-customer-dirs (JM DIE: 53k individual file nodes from 80k files); threshold=50 next time
writeGraphAtomic rename retry handles concurrent viz-server reads; do NOT launch concurrent writers across chat fleet
schemaVersion bump 2.1.0→2.2.0 lands at meta.schemaVersion (downstream-consumer key) — top-level field stays at 2.1.0 for backward read compat
rollback_plan: Revert by deleting all nodes/edges where node.kind ∈ {fs.file, fs.bundle, fs.source} from system-graph.json. The augment is purely additive — no L0-L10 mutations. Layers L11 + L12 declarations can also be removed; schemaVersion can be reverted to 2.1.0. Script + tests survive intact as future tooling.
